Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon and this Digimon are deleted at the same time?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if played by effects, you may return 1 of their suspended Digimon with the lowest DP to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
